summary: FRONTEND-ONLY smoke test (viewport 390x844, static web preview, no rebuild) of the Coach anagrafica blank-page fix and the sibling profiles. All five profile/dashboard routes render correctly with NO 'Cannot access ... before initialization' TDZ errors and NO uncaught pageerrors: /coach/profile, /coach/profile?sign_privacy=1 (opens in edit mode as expected since privacy already signed), /collaboratore/profile (+ ?sign_privacy=1 edit mode), /dirigente/profile, /parent dashboard, /admin dashboard, /admin/coaches (6 coaches listed), and /admin/coach/[id] (opened 'RICA FEDE' detail = /admin/coach/69adf7618a40c8115bda5c2d, textLen 428, renders). Coach dashboard shows PRIVACY (purple, 'Firmata 11/04/2026') + MAPPA PALESTRE (teal) row and tapping PRIVACY correctly navigates to /coach/profile?sign_privacy=1. Collaboratore, Dirigente and Parent dashboards all show the pastel orange 'Calendario Gare Società' banner. ONE BUG FOUND: on /coach the SocietyMatchesLink banner is placed INSIDE the Scanner-tab ScrollView (coach/index.tsx:1071) so it does NOT appear on the default /coach view — missing where the review request expected it (next to PRIVACY / MAPPA PALESTRE). All other roles mount SocietyMatchesLink at the top level of the dashboard body.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Calendario Gare Società' orange banner is rendered inside the Scanner-tab content (app/coach/index.tsx line 1071) instead of in the main dashboard body. On the default landing /coach view only PRIVACY + MAPPA PALESTRE show and the banner is invisible until the user switches to the Scanner tab. Collaboratore, Dirigente, Parent correctly place it at top level (collaboratore/index.tsx:183, dirigente/index.tsx:290, parent/index.tsx:638).

action_items: Move <SocietyMatchesLink /> in /app/frontend/app/coach/index.tsx out of the Scanner-tab ScrollView and render it at the top level of the dashboard body (same position as in collaboratore/dirigente/parent index.tsx), so the orange 'Calendario Gare Società' banner is visible on the default /coach view, next to the PRIVACY/MAPPA PALESTRE row.
After moving, rebuild the static export (npm run build / expo export) since the preview is served from /app/frontend/dist by 'npx serve -s dist' and has no hot reload.
critical_code_review_comments: SocietyMatchesLink is placed inside the Scanner tab block (coach/index.tsx:1071) — likely an oversight when the banner was added to all roles on 13/09/2026.
